description: Search the library of reusable marketing plays (product-agnostic patterns such as a Product Hunt campaign or a Reddit origin-story post). Ranked: whole-word matches of `query`, title hits first; when no play matches every word, the plays matching most of them. Narrow with `type` (channel), `best_for` (audience), `traits` (the plan traits, mapped to audiences) and `funnel_stage`. With no query, library order (strongest first within a type). Each result: slug, title, type, summary, cost, standing, best_for and funnel_stage; open one with get_play. For "what should I do next", whats_next picks for the product’s stage. Read-only.

best_for.description: Only plays that suit one of these audiences.

funnel_stage.description: Only plays for this funnel stage.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "launch", "unlinked mention", "newsletter swap".

traits.description: Product traits that decide which steps apply (b2b, b2c, ai-native, dev-tool, no-code, mcp, has-integrations, eu-traffic, mobile-app); omit for the generic plan. Free tier only; a project's saved traits are used instead.

name: search_plays
title: Search the plays
